note: Guided tour of the SK-3X1 viewer (Tour button). Cameras in model feet (x east, y north, z up), matched to the Blender cameras in blender/pro_look.py; lens in mm on a 36 mm sensor. show = a viewer view key whose layers are shown; add / hide = extra layers. Captions are typical, not engineered.

stops.title: A 3x1 gas power campus
stops.eq: Three H-class gas turbines, three HRSGs and stacks, one steam turbine, an 80-cell air-cooled condenser
stops.sys: 230 kV breaker-and-a-half switchyard; modular power, BESS, carbon capture, LNG, hydrogen and a behind-the-meter data centre
stops.cab: 19,728 cables in the model's cable schedule

stops.title: Gas turbine and generator
stops.eq: H-class gas turbine and hydrogen-cooled generator on the EL 20 turbine deck
stops.sys: The generator makes power at about 21 kV (typical for this class)
stops.cab: Instrument, control and lube-oil skid cables drop from the overhead tray to the skids

stops.title: Isolated-phase bus to the step-up transformer
stops.eq: Isolated-phase bus, generator circuit breaker, unit auxiliary transformer tap, GSU
stops.sys: About 11 kA per phase at 21 kV leaves the generator; the GSU steps it up to 230 kV
stops.cab: No cable on the main path: at these currents it is bus duct. Cable starts at the taps

stops.title: 230 kV breaker-and-a-half switchyard
stops.eq: Circuit breakers, disconnects, CTs and VTs, line take-off gantries
stops.sys: Two breakers per circuit: any breaker can be maintained without an outage
stops.cab: CT / VT and breaker control cable in trench to the relay house; ACSR overhead conductor to the utility

stops.title: 230 kV XLPE cable termination
stops.eq: Outdoor sealing ends, surge arresters, cleated risers, bonding link box
stops.sys: An underground high-voltage link between the yard and a transformer bay
stops.cab: HV XLPE 230 kV, 1/C 2500 kcmil Cu, copper wire screen, aluminium laminate sheath

stops.title: R1: 13.8 kV and 4.16 kV switchgear
stops.eq: Metal-clad switchgear lineups across the operating aisle, MCCs, protection and control panels
stops.sys: The plant runs on its own power: unit auxiliary transformers feed 13.8 kV, then 4.16 kV and 480 V
stops.cab: MV-105 15 kV and 5 kV to motors and transformers; Type TC-ER 600 V power and control

stops.title: R4: the air-cooled condenser fan drives
stops.eq: Two lineups of variable-frequency drives, output trays overhead
stops.sys: One 480 V drive per fan, 80 fans on the air-cooled condenser
stops.cab: VFD cable: three symmetrical grounds and an overall shield, to contain common-mode noise

stops.title: The legend on every jacket
stops.eq: Ladder tray stack over GT1, segregated by voltage class
stops.sys: 13.8 kV feeders and 600 V power, with control and instrumentation in their own trays
stops.cab: ARMOR-X MC-HL and MV-105: the printed legend is how inspectors verify the cable

stops.title: From R1 to the turbine hall
stops.eq: Outdoor medium-voltage tray, HRSG 1 and its stack ahead
stops.sys: Medium-voltage feeders to the gas-turbine auxiliaries
stops.cab: ARMOR-X MC-HL (continuous corrugated aluminium armor) beside MV-105

stops.title: Cable X-ray: every cable on its route
stops.eq: Every run of the cable schedule on its modelled path: tray, duct bank, trench
stops.sys: Coloured by class: HV, MV, 600 V, control, instrumentation, fire alarm, fibre
stops.cab: About 1,120 miles of cable; instrumentation is the largest share

stops.title: HRSG 1: from the e-house to the marshalling box
stops.eq: HRSG casing, EL 42 control and instrument tray, marshalling box
stops.sys: Hundreds of transmitters, valves and thermocouples per HRSG, marshalled locally
stops.cab: Instrumentation PLTC / TC-ER shielded pairs, thermocouple extension, RTD triads

stops.title: The main control room
stops.eq: Six-position operator console facing the video wall
stops.sys: The distributed control system: every signal on the campus ends here
stops.cab: Single-mode armored fibre between buildings; FPLR fire-alarm cable (red jacket)

stops.title: The gas yard: Class I, Division 2
stops.sys: Fuel gas makes this a classified area: every entry is sealed
stops.cab: Rigid conduit with EYS seals, and ARMOR-X MC-HL run exposed on strut

stops.title: LNG: one rack, into the e-house roof
stops.eq: LNG e-house, MC-HL rack to the send-out pumps, reel roller, sheave, capstan
stops.sys: Send-out pump power and controls, with a roof entry into the e-house
stops.cab: ARMOR-X MC-HL pulled from the reel; intrinsically safe instrument cable (blue jacket)

stops.title: The modular power yard
stops.eq: RICE engine hall and SCR stacks, aeroderivatives, fuel cells, microturbines, PCM
stops.sys: Fast-start capacity on its own 13.8 kV collector
stops.cab: MV-105 generator cables on ladder-tray bridges; Type W and SHD-GC on the portable pad

stops.title: Battery energy storage
stops.eq: Battery containers, PCS / MV skids, DC trenches, collector feeders
stops.sys: Rides through load steps and supports the grid in seconds
stops.cab: 2 kV DC conductors in the trench; MV-105 35 kV aluminium collector circuits

stops.title: Carbon capture
stops.eq: Absorbers A to C, strippers, CO2 compression
stops.sys: A large new electrical load: 16 MW-class booster fans per train, compressors
stops.cab: MV-105 to the large drives; HV cable to the carbon-capture transformers

stops.title: Green hydrogen
stops.eq: Electrolyzer hall: five PEM skids, rectifiers, DC trays
stops.sys: Rectified DC at the stacks: a different cable problem
stops.cab: DC conductors in tray from the rectifiers to the PEM stacks

stops.title: Every megawatt travels through a cable
stops.eq: One campus, from the gas turbine to the grid and the data centre
stops.sys: Power, control, instrumentation, fire alarm and fibre
stops.cab: About 1,120 miles of cable, mapped on its route
